integrity: Statement and proof are self-contained, including the exact compression identity, conditional distribution, and elliptic-integral normalization. Packaged numerical checks are corroborative, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed B>Delta>0 and fixed t>0; eta tends to zero. No uniform finite-eta error bound, general-shape theorem, nonuniform viewing measure, or independent historical-priority determination. The existing fixed-shape near-circular coefficient is not presented as new.
title: Cassini-oval crossover for nearly circular shadows of nearly oblate ellipsoids
